preconditions.description: Room dimensions n and m are integers between 1 and 50, with at least one even dimension.

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.splitlines()) == 2 * n + 1 and all(len(line) == m for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:2 * n + 1])
preconditions.description: Input consists of exactly 2n+1 lines: first line with n and m, followed by n lines of current configuration, then n lines of desired configuration, each line having exactly m characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'LRUD' for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:2 * n + 1] for c in line)
preconditions.description: Each character in the configurations is one of 'L', 'R', 'U', or 'D'.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (k := int(stdout.splitlines()[0]) and 0 <= k <= 100000 and all(len(op.split()) == 2 and 1 <= int(op.split()[0]) <= n and 1 <= int(op.split()[1]) <= m - 1 for op in stdout.splitlines()[1:k + 1]))
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, output k (number of operations, 0 ≤ k ≤ 100000) followed by k lines of operations, each specifying a 2×2 square's top-left half-tile coordinates (1-based row and column). If no solution exists, output -1.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (current := stdin.splitlines()[1:n + 1], desired := stdin.splitlines()[n + 1:2 * n + 1], and apply_operations(current, stdout.splitlines()[1:]) == desired)
postconditions.description: The sequence of operations, when applied to the current configuration, transforms it into the desired configuration. If no such sequence exists, output -1.
